title: Moroccan Lamb Couscous
description: Traditional Moroccan dish with flavorful lamb and fluffy couscous. This recipe is perfect for a hearty dinner.

ingredients.name: Moroccan Spices
ingredients.notes: Blend of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat the royal olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Moroccan spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lively lemon juice and spicy harissa. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes or until the lamb is cooked through.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the couscous according to package instructions.
Once the lamb is cooked, fluff the couscous with a fork and serve with the lamb mixture on top.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
